summary: This is a routine debt offering prospectus supplement filed by VICI Properties L.P. under Rule 424(b)(5). The issuer is offering $900 million of 5.400% Senior Notes due 2031 and $850 million of 5.750% Senior Notes due 2036, for an aggregate principal of $1.75 billion. Net proceeds will be used to repay existing senior notes due 2026 and for general corporate purposes. The notes are unsecured, unsubordinated obligations of the issuer, structurally subordinated to subsidiary liabilities, and not listed on any exchange. No special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring is involved; it is an ordinary capital markets transaction. The filing is a standard debt issuance, not a special situation. What to watch: execution and use of proceeds, but no risk-arb angle.
